definitions.explanation: An artificial channel built to supply water for agriculture, industry, or other uses. Common in rural Japan for rice paddy irrigation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{田|た}んぼ→田んぼ：00402_tanbo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧{用水路|ようすいろ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is an irrigation channel that supplies water to the rice paddies.

examples.japanese: {用水路|ようすいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{協力|きょうりょく}して→協力する：25370_kyouryokusuru⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Cleaning the irrigation channels is done cooperatively by the local residents.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{用水路|ようすいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧あふれて、⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{冠水|かんすい}→冠水：20916_kansui⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The water overflowed from the irrigation channel due to heavy rain, and the road was flooded.

notes: A compound of ⟦{用水|ようすい}→用水：29725_yousui⟧ (water for use, utility water) and {路|ろ} (route, channel). In rural Japan, maintaining {用水路|ようすいろ} is traditionally a communal responsibility. During heavy rains, overflowing channels can be dangerous — every year, accidents occur when people try to check on {用水路|ようすいろ} during storms. Related terms: ⟦{水路|すいろ}→水路：13264_suiro⟧ (waterway, more general), ⟦{灌漑|かんがい}→灌漑：06429_kangai⟧ (irrigation), and {排水路|はいすいろ} (drainage channel).
